# openmetadata_storage_service Data Source

Looks up a single OpenMetadata storage service by id or fully qualified name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_storage_service" "data_lake" {
  fully_qualified_name = "data-lake"
}

output "data_lake_storage_service_id" {
  value = data.openmetadata_storage_service.data_lake.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Storage service fully qualified name. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.
- `id` (String) Storage service UUID. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Markdown description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `name` (String) Storage service name.
- `service_type` (String) OpenMetadata service type such as S3, GCS, ADLS, CustomStorage.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.
